title: Conversation for Non-verifiable Learning: Self-Evolving LLMs through Meta-Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the ranking quality of LLM judges using Spearman's rank correlation (Rank-ρ) against ground-truth correctness labels to ensure evaluators accurately distinguish correct solutions without gaming the system or conforming blindly to peers.

Tracking the average solution length (action tokens) across training steps to evaluate whether the model's internal evaluator inappropriately learns to favor longer, more verbose responses over actual quality, comparing the proposed method against self-rewarding baselines.
